You can export your ChatGPT conversations `using OpenAI's built-in data export tool, browser extensions, or manual methods`.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1QEBxCJF12f9s-3xs2NadWHTXUkpzoxskXKl6iwvcuR1Tfp3Nz2vAT6QK9xdWo9OzoTPbr4nO9YgDrqUfPzc8I7XQBdC5_ri3ekzvNiMk7dJkekUEWlCOEWZ5wZ7JjTqpDBgrLlCHADiudZVA5cNzQfALssH63csWBiMmBtJtedi0i64th_WhwbsE02BlQZeo71pB5B5MYgSQL6XG6hlox6uAzAL1qg0blMJuxNz9T3axr2IT7nMr8fiTpJb1q3V0N_If78_K-2aSCMviinwUxsfU3n9ut0)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jeS1JSln5T8&t=1)

### Method 1: Export All Chat History (Official Way)

OpenAI lets you download your entire chat history as a ZIP file containing JSON and HTML files.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF163bS0uok4X0w07TmQ05dOpdSuIYfXnTKjQ0mCUJplCrrrepNqaoJzuuYvXuILM8IPSwvKKTV-0Q2nrc3ZsDgGZh4XOAzoeDbG75XfpaqWHXD1HporzCnGEeiN77tMx5garTWAC1wu-As1CXkKac_tVGMXoSujKcig4PF8G_XJrrR8rCyzxXn3_eKzQ)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nque60rkbe8)

1. Log in to [ChatGPT](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESUAHEIkXXR_MCmPzPiwFqRXSnmq5-_yY8F61jifiOWGJJAZ0TT7rOFCB1ISq7-RxElMQnLVm9oB3itpzL7O527I7rfVmQsFaj7ro9lzY0MW2_).
2. Click your **profile icon** in the bottom-left corner.
3. Select **Settings** > **Data controls**.
4. Click **Export** or **Export data** , then confirm the request.
5. Complete any verification prompts (such as a code sent via email or SMS).
6. Wait for an email from OpenAI (this can take anywhere from a few minutes up to 7 days).
7. Click **Download data export** in the email. *Note: The link expires after 24 hours.* 
8. Unzip the downloaded file to view your data, which includes a readable `chat.html` file or raw JSON files.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/3QbxZr7J4L4)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E08P_Of2Ui8&t=4)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jeS1JSln5T8&t=1)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF163bS0uok4X0w07TmQ05dOpdSuIYfXnTKjQ0mCUJplCrrrepNqaoJzuuYvXuILM8IPSwvKKTV-0Q2nrc3ZsDgGZh4XOAzoeDbG75XfpaqWHXD1HporzCnGEeiN77tMx5garTWAC1wu-As1CXkKac_tVGMXoSujKcig4PF8G_XJrrR8rCyzxXn3_eKzQ)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nque60rkbe8)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXX4fL2V5E3KEyaY41yqPaZf2VNbhbBeZ92v7hRAFoCN_sP7RArCrZyqsg14Xp4L20KKRSOI9rlvW4Cl9JwLALnTd-byEsapT1aDTCLIsMMqoenWbNbr5oia3Ia8grXhTePZ1JZlir58NPpdKCu)[[7]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/esX4PAb2rbc)

### Method 2: Export a Single Conversation
If you only need to save or share one specific chat thread:

- **Share a read-only link:** Open the conversation, click the **Share** icon at the top right, and choose **Copy link**.
- **Save as PDF via browser:** Open the conversation, press `Ctrl + P` (Windows) or `Command + P` (Mac), and select **Save as PDF** as your destination.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF18nC0NrzDggT-rwlOwiKyW-1SiFSyKIQSgLb9moMBSCv4QbSB56lfo-mbTVn1E3yN40iwA14NmIQtylZ39GZZz_S0JGm2IbJVkZqW5TDsShIwVIClcoPmk9X6YX1ox0ipitL24Nzk37ujbq44kaRkMmvH__QRI6gw3ghCVKSDRU8gWqeFVD3Ma8jHUhMxZkiN0d9MloU)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jeS1JSln5T8&t=1)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E08P_Of2Ui8&t=4)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3rCVXWIthDc&vl=en-US&t=9)

### Method 3: Use Browser Extensions or Scripts
Opinions are mixed on manual methods for large threads, as users on the [OpenAI Community Forum](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1QEBxCJF12f9s-3xs2NadWHTXUkpzoxskXKl6iwvcuR1Tfp3Nz2vAT6QK9xdWo9OzoTPbr4nO9YgDrqUfPzc8I7XQBdC5_ri3ekzvNiMk7dJkekUEWlCOEWZ5wZ7JjTqpDBgrLlCHADiudZVA5cNzQfALssH63csWBiMmBtJtedi0i64th_WhwbsE02BlQZeo71pB5B5MYgSQL6XG6hlox6uAzAL1qg0blMJuxNz9T3axr2IT7nMr8fiTpJb1q3V0N_If78_K-2aSCMviinwUxsfU3n9ut0) note that lengthy threads can become cumbersome to manage. Many users prefer third-party options for more readable formats like Markdown, Word, Notion, or PDF:[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/exportgpt-export-chatgpt/jamcijfplmgbngnppdhmbbogjebgfimn)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1QEBxCJF12f9s-3xs2NadWHTXUkpzoxskXKl6iwvcuR1Tfp3Nz2vAT6QK9xdWo9OzoTPbr4nO9YgDrqUfPzc8I7XQBdC5_ri3ekzvNiMk7dJkekUEWlCOEWZ5wZ7JjTqpDBgrLlCHADiudZVA5cNzQfALssH63csWBiMmBtJtedi0i64th_WhwbsE02BlQZeo71pB5B5MYgSQL6XG6hlox6uAzAL1qg0blMJuxNz9T3axr2IT7nMr8fiTpJb1q3V0N_If78_K-2aSCMviinwUxsfU3n9ut0)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3rCVXWIthDc&vl=en-US&t=9)

- **Chrome Extensions:** Tools like [ExportGPT: Export ChatGPT Conversation](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/exportgpt-export-chatgpt/jamcijfplmgbngnppdhmbbogjebgfimn) let you one-click export active chats into PDF, Markdown, HTML, or Excel.[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/exportgpt-export-chatgpt/jamcijfplmgbngnppdhmbbogjebgfimn)
- **Open Source Scripts:** Developers can use command-line tools or console scripts like the [ChatGPT Conversation Exporter](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXnIgTRi4BKfgV21Bs1W3LjMkcw-D-bvtRfK3teFxhyzNmDLN3zHRVx5LTlW3cW1ECWmhErQL1LZd4I9rDgdqtXbHeDfLtAidmYnIWJc1-Yotu0LiJHC8gWon9iL4Nc0e3C2yawzhJZ0s0b1Dza8cI8VDc-4gC1sg) to pull full histories directly into local Markdown and JSON files.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXnIgTRi4BKfgV21Bs1W3LjMkcw-D-bvtRfK3teFxhyzNmDLN3zHRVx5LTlW3cW1ECWmhErQL1LZd4I9rDgdqtXbHeDfLtAidmYnIWJc1-Yotu0LiJHC8gWon9iL4Nc0e3C2yawzhJZ0s0b1Dza8cI8VDc-4gC1sg)

What people are saying

I am begging you, export your ChatGPT history this week.

You've spent years telling it about your projects, your health and how you write. All of that lives on OpenAI's servers.

If OpenAI locks, bans or loses your account, you lose those chats with it. You also can't move them to Claude, Gemini or a model on your own laptop.

In ChatGPT, open Settings → Data controls → Export data, and OpenAI emails you a zip of every chat. In Claude, you'll find the same button under Settings → Privacy.

Save the zip on your own drive. Then copy the parts that matter into one plain notes file, so any AI can read it, including the open source model you downloaded last weekend.

The export takes one click and a minute of your time.

Keep your AI memory on a drive you own.
